description: List bounded records from local Samsung Health CSV/ZIP export data. Use type/start/end filters to keep output small.

incremental_cache.description: When true and `type` is set, skip records already seen in a previous call (per-category cache at ~/.samsung-health-mcp/incremental-cache.json). Cache auto-invalidates when the export file mtime changes.

type.description: Samsung Health record type, e.g. samsung_health_steps.

name: samsung_health_list_records
title: List Samsung Health Records
